items.name: SourceDocument
items.role: Source-bound document identity entering the typed new-write path.
items.notes: Distinct from supervisor program_ast_adapters.SourceDocument, which is an analysis AST surface and is not the logic formalization SourceDocument.

items.name: syntax_core
items.role: Canonical parse/AST package for logic expressions on the typed new-write path.
items.notes: LPC-004 conflict policy treats syntax_core as read-only production source. Unit tests under tests/unit/logic/syntax_core are the plan validation surface for LPC-G040.

items.name: syntax_core parse artifact
items.role: Parse output binding source spans and raw syntax before typing.
items.notes: Exact class name not readable in this worktree; inventory entry is the plan pipeline stage.

items.name: TypedExpression
items.role: Typed expression identity required on every new formalization write.
items.notes: LPC-040 acceptance requires new writes to bind expression identity together with source, digest, spans, family/profile/property/view/notation, features, assumptions, unsupported extensions, status, and content identity.

items.name: ElaborationArtifact
items.role: Elaboration between TypedExpression and FormalizationArtifact@3.
items.notes: Exact module placement (syntax_core vs formalization) not confirmed without datasets source; classified as typed-expression pipeline stage.

items.name: agent_supervisor.analysis.program_ast_adapters.SourceDocument
items.role: Supervisor repository/program analysis document type; not the logic formalization SourceDocument.
items.notes: Name collision with logic SourceDocument. Must not be treated as a formalization AST generation.

items.name: FormalizationArtifact@3
items.role: Only admitted formalization generation for new writes. Binds source, typed-expression identity, family/profile/property/view/notation, assumptions, unsupported extensions, status, and content identity.
items.notes: LPC-040 conflict policy: preserve artifacts_v3 while adding admission helper.

items.name: formalization.artifacts_v3 module
items.role: Module owning FormalizationArtifact@3 wire/types and content identity.
items.notes: Listed separately from the type so module vs generation roles stay distinct.

items.name: FormalizationArtifact (compiler surface)
items.role: Live import path used by supervisor admissibility tests and proof-corpus envelope builders. Not the plan-named @3 new-write generation.
items.notes: Relationship to artifacts_v3 (alias, facade, or older generation) cannot be confirmed without datasets source. Classified legacy relative to FormalizationArtifact@3 new-write authority.

items.name: FormalizationArtifact@1
items.role: Implied historical generation from artifacts_v3 naming.
items.notes: No distinct path, import, or LPC predicted file observed. Must not be used for new writes.

items.name: FormalizationArtifact@2
items.role: Implied historical generation from artifacts_v3 naming.
items.notes: No distinct path, import, or LPC predicted file observed. Must not be used for new writes.

items.name: formalization.admission
items.role: Planned LPC-040 admission helper enforcing FormalizationArtifact@3 and DomainLogicSlice@2 on new writes.
items.notes: Predicted path only until LPC-040 lands. Does not replace artifacts_v3.

items.name: formalization.proposal_advisors
items.role: Untrusted proposal/advisor surface (Leanstral, SymAI, static proposals). Candidate-only; never raises proof authority.
items.notes: Imported by accelerate certification tooling. Not a FormalizationArtifact generation.

items.name: formalization.autoencoder_advisor
items.role: Bounded formalization advisor adapted from modal autoencoder. Proposal-only.
items.notes: Not a FormalizationArtifact generation and cannot satisfy kernel-required policy.

items.name: proof_corpus.ArtifactEnvelope.from_intent_artifact
items.role: Envelope builder wrapping FormalizationArtifact for proof-corpus storage and admissibility fixtures.
items.notes: Consumes FormalizationArtifact; does not define a new formalization generation.

items.name: DomainLogicSlice@2
items.role: Canonical domain lowering contract after FormalizationArtifact@3. Declares source domain, view, family/profile, property, notation, preserved/lost semantics, assumptions, unsupported constructs, proof-safety, and counterexample-safety.
items.notes: Exact defining module not readable here; plan interfaces name DomainLogicSlice@2 alongside FormalizationArtifact@3.

items.name: DomainLogicSlice@1
items.role: Implied historical generation from DomainLogicSlice@2 naming.
items.notes: No distinct path or import observed. Must not be used for executable new writes.

items.name: legal_ir.domain_slice
items.role: Legal domain adapter. Must keep TDFOL, DCEC, and frame logic distinct; must not map them to generic FOL/deontic/object framing.
items.notes: LPC-041 predicted path. Families remain distinct under DomainLogicSlice@2.

items.name: security_ir.domain_slice
items.role: Security domain adapter lowering security IR without collapsing software-verification families.
items.notes: LPC-042 predicted path. Live accelerate imports currently target security_ir.cvefixes.* rather than domain_slice.

items.name: software_verification.domain_slice
items.role: Software-verification domain adapter. Keep contracts, STS, authorization, concurrency, separation, hyperproperties, protocols, and monitors distinct.
items.notes: LPC-042 predicted path. Broader software_verification package is heavily imported for tactician/protocol/authorization surfaces, which are not DomainLogicSlice generations.

items.name: crypto_ir.domain_slice
items.role: Crypto domain adapter lowering crypto IR through DomainLogicSlice@2.
items.notes: LPC-042 predicted path.

items.name: intent_ir.domain_slice
items.role: Intent domain adapter. Same adapter contract as legal/security; no universal domain IR.
items.notes: LPC-043 predicted path. Accelerate also references intent_ir/graphrag/retrieval.py for LPR, which is not a DomainLogicSlice generation.

items.name: ui_ux_ir.domain_slice
items.role: UI/UX domain adapter. Same adapter contract as legal/security; no universal domain IR.
items.notes: LPC-043 predicted path.

items.name: unadmitted DomainLogicSlice@2 rejection
items.role: LPC-044 gate: executable BackendRequest construction must reject work lacking an admitted DomainLogicSlice@2.
items.notes: Test/gate surface predicted by LPC-044; not a slice generation itself.
